contexts.text: The number of them was... thousands of thousands () = all in... goods... For a thousand is predicated of goods, because it is a smaller number than a myriad, which is predicated of truths; and truths are manifold, but goods are simple. Illustrated. AE 316:23. AE 336:3. AE 336:4, Illustrated.
Thousands = innumerable things, and are predicated of good.
The reason thousands is that ten = many things...
But when innumerable things which are infinitely many are to be expressed, it is said thousands of thousands.
A thousand shall fall at thy side () = the destruction of these evils.
A thousand of thousands ministered unto Him () relates to the Divine good.
The myriads of the thousands of Israel () = the implanted truths from good of which is the Church.
